$comment: Every ceremony a link can open on the app origin, named once (ADR 0140 §3, ADR 0139). A path is relative to the deployment's base (Pages serves under /OpenSesame/); `{name}` is one path segment. A bearer rides in the fragment, never the query, and a query carries only display artifacts (a user code) or a by-reference handle. `legacy` lists the link shapes printed before the canonical ones: they are read, never emitted. Consumers: packages/ceremony-kit (src/ceremony-routes.generated.ts via scripts/emit-ceremony-routes.mjs; the link builders and parsers, the authenticator invocation), packages/control-plane (INTERACTION_ROUTE: the /i/:ref short link and the rendezvous launcher), apps/android (AndroidManifest.xml app-link pathPrefix and OID4VC schemes); each has a drift test against this file.

claim.summary: Ownership claim (#token=), or a drop when the fragment also carries key (#token=&key=)

invoke.summary: Authenticator hand-off: open the native app, or fall back to the browser ceremony

guest.summary: Alias for the guest road (ADR 0140 D12)

delegate.summary: Alias into Join a session (ADR 0136, ADR 0140 D5)
